## Skill descriptions (routing triggers)

| skill | description | trigger check |
|---|---|---|
| clarify | Ask the user structured questions (rounds of numbered questions, each with a recommended answer) until both sides share one understanding. Use when Frank asks to be grilled or to clarify, before building a feature whose goal, scope, or acceptance is unclear, and as the first stage of the product cycle. Not for small, clear tasks. | ok |
| complaints | Frank's register of complaints about Claude and feature requests in ~/devel/myclaude/requirements/complaints. Use when Frank says "record this complaint", "complain to myclaude", "log this pain point", "add a request", "record this feature request", "I need <capability> for <work>", "work on my complaints", "check my complaints", or pastes a frustrating exchange and asks to record it. | ok |
| config-management | Manage Frank's Claude Code config in ~/devel/myclaude - update sources, pick or fork items, sync into ~/.claude, and run the monthly setup review. Use when Frank says "update my config", "review my setup", "add repo X", "pick their Y", "anything we can improve?", or asks why an installed file is out of date. | ok |
| deep-research | Run a PI-led multi-agent research programme with parallel researchers, critique rounds, adversarial citation checks, and a graded-evidence synthesis. | ok |
| diagnosing-bugs | Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow. | ok |
| improve-codebase-architecture | Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then work through the one the user picks with structured questions. | ok |
| observability-buildout | Observability buildout and review for a service, OpenTelemetry-first and vendor-neutral (design doc, OTel instrumentation, Collector, SLOs with burn-rate alerts, observability as code, end-to-end verification). Use when designing, reviewing, or extending monitoring, alerting, observability, tracing, SLOs, dashboards, or OpenTelemetry for a service. | ok |
| pr-workflow | The one PR process for Frank's GitHub PRs - scope, reviewers, Copilot review with every thread fixed or rebutted and resolved, green CI. Use when opening a PR, or before calling any PR done or merging it. | ok |
| tdd | Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests. | ok |
| writing-for-agents | Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, agent definitions (agents/*.md), rules (rules/*.md), or AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md. | ok |
| codebase-design | Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary. | ok |
| domain-modeling | Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a CONTEXT.md, or recording or editing an ADR. | ok |
| wait-what | Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it. | ok |
